hypothesis: A short low-learning-rate continuation may modestly improve prediction and some continuations; character/plot consistency is not guaranteed.
schedule: stage-local cosine, retain AdamW moments/counters and RNG streams
unchanged: same 58,968 training stories, tokenizer, architecture, masks, batch size, BF16, dropout, optimizer groups and development 200
development: same 46,082 events, FP32 evaluation every 500 additional updates; used for selection
selection: minimum fixed-development NLL including the parent; ties keep parent; no test-driven selection
fresh_final_rule: first 200 sorted normalized-group IDs in final_holdout bucket excluding every old 8MiB group and the used recovery final 200
fresh_final_access: encode/score after completed budget and candidate freeze only; then used evidence
evaluation: compare parent versus selected candidate with identical 4096 tokenizer and context 256 on the new 200 texts
prompts: Once upon a time there was a fox and it was blue, but
One day, Lily lost her red balloon.
A small rabbit found a carrot beside the river.
Tom wanted to help his friend.
Mia found a small red box.
The little bird was afraid of the rain.
promotion: review all paired samples; app/model ZIP unchanged until a reviewed decision
limitations: one continued training trajectory, development-informed budget; prior final sets stay used and are not rescored
